meta.description: Rhode Island movers for Providence homes, apartments and offices. A licensed carrier with its own trucks and crews from Brighton, Boston. Free quote.

overview: Looking for Rhode Island movers that own their trucks? Better Life Moving is a licensed interstate carrier from Brighton, Boston, and our crews take Providence moves across town, out to other Rhode Island towns or over state lines.
Before you book, you'll see how the job is priced, including the drive down from our yard.
sellingPoints: Our own trucks and crews, no broker
Moves inside Rhode Island and out of state

servicesBlock.h2: Moving Services for Providence and the Rest of Rhode Island
servicesBlock.intro: Apartment and house moves make up most of what people ask us for in Providence, and packing often gets added on. Some customers need storage for a few weeks while they wait on the next place. We also move offices, single heavy pieces like a piano, and full households heading to another state. Every service on this list is done by our own people, from the first box to the last bolt on the bed frame.

whyChoose.h2: Why Providence Customers Call a Boston Carrier

cards.title: A Carrier, Not a Broker
cards.text: The company that quotes your Providence move is the one whose crew carries it. Your job is never sold on to a stranger with a rented truck.

cards.title: The Drive Is on the Quote
cards.text: Our crews set out from Brighton, so travel time is part of the price. It appears on the quote before you agree to anything, never as a surprise line at the end.

cards.title: Authority Anyone Can Look Up
cards.text: We hold federal interstate authority as USDOT 3866930, MC 1414489. Those numbers take about a minute to check on the FMCSA public record.

cards.title: Wrapped and Strapped
cards.text: Furniture is wrapped piece by piece and strapped in place once it is loaded. Blankets, shrink wrap, tape and truck costs (gas, mileage, tolls) are included in the hourly rate.

faq.q: Do you move people anywhere in Rhode Island, or only in Providence?
faq.a: We take moves all over Rhode Island, not just inside Providence. Send us both addresses and the manager will confirm the date, the crew size and how the move is priced.

faq.q: Where do your crews start from on a Providence job?
faq.a: From our head office at 20 Presentation Rd in Brighton, Boston. The drive counts as travel time, which is why it shows up on your quote.

faq.q: How is a move out of Providence priced?
faq.a: That depends on where you are going. Local moves are billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added, and long distance moves are quoted at a flat rate. Your quote names which one applies.

faq.q: Can you move me from Providence up to Boston?
faq.a: Yes. Boston is where most of our crews work every day, so a Providence to Boston move ends on familiar ground. Share the dates and both addresses for a price.

faq.q: How can I check whether a Rhode Island mover is licensed for interstate moves?
faq.a: Search the company's USDOT number on the FMCSA website. Ours is USDOT 3866930, MC 1414489, registered to Better Life Moving LLC as a carrier.

faqClosing: Still comparing companies? Our FAQ page covers deposits, payment timing and what the crew does on moving day.

closing.h2: Price Your Providence Move With Us
closing.body: Tell us the move date, both addresses and anything heavy or fragile. A manager will come back with the price and walk you through how it was worked out.
